_why.45-terminal: A live shell (Terminal node): its ink is what the shell holds - an idle one is a prompt line, a busy one fills the tile - so small content / an empty bottom is what an idle terminal is, not a layout fault; the preview's mock shell prints one line and opens no session past a few tiles (the 4x4s draw nothing). Fix only by giving the preview a real shell's output.
